projects.title: Stories Between the Letters
projects.description: I loved discovering how typography, colour, and composition could change the mood of a poster. Made in Adobe Photoshop, these three pieces explore cinematic stories through a visual language of their own.

projects.title: KeyMitra — A Key to Everyday Ease
projects.description: I made KeyMitra while exploring design research. I enjoyed taking what I was learning and turning it into an app idea for keymakers—thinking through the information they might need and how the interface could make it easier to find.

projects.title: Dear Zindagi — Life Through My Lens
projects.description: I shot Dear Zindagi while learning photography and videography. I loved exploring how framing, light, and movement could turn an everyday moment into a story, then bringing those moments together in a film.

projects.title: Tomorrow, Dreamed in Motion
projects.description: I made this video while experimenting with AI tools. I loved exploring how a prompt could become a moving image, trying different visual directions, and seeing an imagined future take shape on screen.
